intent.outcome: The Formulae main pane is a modern, full-bleed data table: List (tab 0) owns the entire content region under the tab bar with a real multi-column table (aligned columns, header row, row windowing). Detail tabs (Info/Deps/…) stay available. Outdated-first ordering, underline tabs, sidebar remains the selection source of truth.

problem.description: The central pane for Formulae is a single-item Info text dump (or empty). The only 'table-like' UI is sidebar lines built with padRight pseudo-columns (presentation.FormatFormula) — fixed widths, no header, no full-pane layout. There is no real columnar table that uses the whole main content width×height as the primary browse surface.

in_scope: Primary goal: List tab renders a REAL table that occupies the full main content area (the width,height passed into renderContent — edge to edge under tab bar, above log). Not a small centered block; not padRight pseudo-columns.

Implementation: prefer github.com/charmbracelet/lipgloss/table (already available via lipgloss v1.1.0) OR an equivalent custom renderer with true column boxes. Do NOT reuse presentation.FormatFormula padRight strings for the main pane. bubbles/table is OK only if its cursor is fully driven by panel.selected (no second independent cursor).

Layout contract: (1) header row always visible at top of content; (2) body uses remaining height rows with offset windowing synced to selection (selected row kept in view); (3) total rendered block Width=width and Height=height via lipgloss sizing; (4) column widths sum to content width (Name flexes; Version/Status/Tap get min widths then remainder to Name).

Columns: Name | Version | Status | Tap. Version = 'old -> new' when Outdated && NewVersion set, else Version. Status label: outdated | pinned | installed (outdated if Outdated; else pinned if Pinned; else installed). Status cell uses theme colors (OutdatedBadge / PinnedBadge / InstalledBadge). Tap shortened (homebrew/core -> hb/c).
Prepend List to panelTabs[PanelFormulae]: [List, Info, Deps, Used By, Caveats, Files]. Shift needsTabFetch Formulae indices 1,2,4 -> 2,3,5. renderContent case 0 -> table; Info..Files -> 1..5.
Sort: apply outdatedRank, pinnedRank, nameLower when Formulae panel data is loaded so sidebar and table share one order.
Selection: sidebar is source of truth (j/k = panel up/down). Table highlights the selected row (SelectedItem / accent row style). No independent table cursor.
Empty state centered in the full content box: 'No formulae yet' + 'Press / to search & install'.
Tab bar RESTYLE only (already top of main pane): active bold + thick bottom Accent border; inactive Subtle. Breadcrumb unchanged.
Sidebar list may stay FormatFormula for M16 (compact name-only sidebar is optional polish, not required). Main pane must not look like the sidebar.

Tests: full-pane sizing (output respects width/height); header present; column presence; sort; version arrow; status labels+that colored styles applied where assertable; empty state; tab order; fetch index shift; selection highlight; selected row stays in window.
out_of_scope: Rolling the same full-pane table to Casks/Outdated/Taps/Services/Search (future milestone).
In-tab filter, column resize UI, or user-controlled sort.
Independent table cursor / making table the only navigator.
Rewriting sidebar to name-only (optional later polish).

acceptance_criteria.description: Formulae tabs are exactly: List, Info, Deps, Used By, Caveats, Files (List prepended; names/order of the rest unchanged). Tab bar remains at top of main pane under breadcrumb.
Active tab style is bold with thick bottom border (Accent); inactive tabs are dimmed (Subtle) with no border.
List tab renders a real multi-column table (not padRight pseudo-columns) with header Name | Version | Status | Tap that fills the full main content width and height (renderContent box).
Version cell shows "Version -> NewVersion" when formula.Outdated and NewVersion non-empty; otherwise shows Version only.
Status cell is one of: outdated, pinned, installed (outdated if Outdated; else pinned if Pinned; else installed).
Formulae panel data (sidebar + List table) shares one order: outdated first, then non-outdated pinned, then remaining A-Z by name (case-insensitive).
Empty formulae list on List tab shows centered "No formulae yet" and "Press / to search & install".
needsTabFetch / renderContent / tests use shifted Formulae tab indices (Deps=2, Used By=3, Files=5; Caveats=4). List tab does not trigger tab fetch.
List table highlights the row for the sidebar-selected formula; j/k still move sidebar selection (no separate table cursor).
Table layout: sticky header; body windowed to remaining height; selected row kept in view; column widths sum to content width (Name flexes).
Status cells use themed colors (OutdatedBadge / PinnedBadge / InstalledBadge), not plain monochrome text only.

design_decisions.choice: Restyle underline tabs in place at top of main pane; do not move
design_decisions.rationale: renderMainPanel already joins breadcrumb, tabBar, content, cmdLog. Prior spec wrongly claimed sidebar-bottom placement. M16 only changes TabActive/TabInactive (or local styles) to bold+thick bottom border vs dim.

design_decisions.choice: List is tab 0; keep Info|Deps|Used By|Caveats|Files as tabs 1-5
design_decisions.rationale: Prepend-only avoids dropping Caveats and preserves Used By spelling. Fetch maps must shift 1,2,4 -> 2,3,5.

design_decisions.choice: 4 columns Name|Version|Status|Tap; Name flex-width; others min-width; fill full content width
design_decisions.rationale: Fixed padRight (22/12) is what makes today feel like fake tables. Real layout distributes width so the table reads as a full pane, not a left-aligned text dump.

design_decisions.choice: outdatedRank then pinnedRank then nameLower; no user sort UI
design_decisions.rationale: Action-first. Two separate ranks — do not collapse outdated and pinned into one 0/1 flag.

design_decisions.choice: Sidebar selection is source of truth; List table highlights the same row
design_decisions.rationale: Avoid dual cursors. j/k keep existing panel.up/down behavior; table is a richer view of the same list.

design_decisions.choice: Apply the same outdated>pinned>alpha sort to Formulae panel data so sidebar items and List table share one order
design_decisions.rationale: If only the table sorted, j/k on the sidebar would jump seemingly at random relative to table rows. One sorted slice drives both views; highlight-by-name still works as a safety net.

design_decisions.choice: lipgloss/table (preferred) or equivalent full-width column renderer; not FormatFormula padRight; bubbles/table only if cursor is slave to panel.selected
design_decisions.rationale: Goal is a real columnar widget owning the central pane. lipgloss/table fits View()-only rendering with external selection. Avoid a second cursor model.

design_decisions.choice: Table fills renderContent width×height: sticky header, windowed body, selected row kept visible
design_decisions.rationale: Without explicit full-bleed layout the runner can ship a correct-but-tiny table and miss the product goal of a modern central pane.
Color is part of modern table readability; plain monochrome status reverts to text-list feel.
